founder.quote: I cut every piece myself and stitch it by hand — no machines, no shortcuts. The hide I use takes six weeks to tan in an oak bark pit, and you'll feel that density the first time you hold one of these belts.
founder.attribution: Jordan Merck, maker and sole proprietor
